data.description: 飘着初雪的城市公园步道上，莉音穿着收腰长款风衣与保暖皮靴，黑色长发与雪白的围巾形成鲜明对比。她将冻得有些发红的双手插进大衣口袋，侧目看向你——「气温已经降至零度以下，但……像这样两个人并肩走在雪地里，体感温度似乎比数据预测的要温暖许多。」
data.promptProse: Rio carries her paper coffee cup in both hands on the left, her long black hair loose over a fitted black winter coat. The man walking on her right has swept-back brown hair, a gray knit scarf and a camel overcoat. She glances across at his profile as the first snow catches in the shop-window light.
data.title: 调月莉音 · 冬季街道漫步
